title: Relationship of urinary bisphenol A in childhood on thyroid hormone function in adolescents: a cohort study.
authors: Choi JE, Choi EJ, Lee S, Park B, Lee HA, Hong YS, Ha E, Kim HS, Park H.
tables: Linear regression analysis results for the effect of log-transformed urinary BPA concentrations at two time points on serum thyroid concentrations at ages 10–12.
